memory_candidates: nf_drop_last_cross: cross-structure version of nf_drop_last. If M,envM and N,envN agree on all depth-k (n+1)-var NFs, then M,envM compose castSucc and N,envN compose castSucc agree on all depth-k n-var NFs. Proved by induction on k mirroring nf_drop_last. The k=0 case uses atom_agreement_from_nf + castSucc atom embedding. The k+1 case uses fin_cons_castSucc_comm to rewrite Fin.cons y (env compose castSucc) = (Fin.cons y env) compose castSucc, then applies the IH.

constenv_nvar_to_2var proof structure: iterate nf_drop_last_cross via Nat induction on n. At each step, apply nf_drop_last_cross to constenv at arity (n'+3), then rewrite via constenv_castSucc to get constenv at arity (n'+2). Clean 4-line proof.

constenv_2var_determines blocker: the k+1 quantifier case requires showing (n+2)-var agreement on [y,x,t,...,t] envs from 3-var agreement on [y,x,t]. These extended envs have prefix [y,x] and constant tail t, but are NOT of the form Fin.cons a (fun _ => b). The fix is to generalize the theorem to handle envs with arbitrary prefix length p: from (p+1)-var agreement on [prefix, t, ..., t] envs, derive (p+n)-var agreement.
